description:
Find AI summaries by meaning; use search_meeting_content for stored words.

    Results carry relevance_score and a summary preview. Narrow with government,
    category_tag, topic or dates; get_meeting retrieves the full summary.

category_tag.description: Optional meeting-type filter — an opaque category_tag from discover_meeting_vocabulary (not a guessable slug).
category_tag.title: Category Tag

government_id.description: Optional account_id (from find_local_governments) to restrict the search to one government.
government_id.title: Government Id

government_ids.description: Optional list of account_ids to search across several governments at once (e.g. to compare cities). Overrides government_id.
government_ids.title: Government Ids

match_type.description: Semantic only; use search_meeting_content for keyword searches.
match_type.title: Match Type

min_score.description: Optional semantic relevance floor 0-1 (default 0.4). Raise to return only strong matches; lower to widen recall.
min_score.title: Min Score

query.description: What to search for in plain language, e.g. 'short-term rental regulations' or 'police budget overtime'.
query.title: Query

topic.description: Optional topic filter — a topic name from discover_meeting_vocabulary, e.g. 'Affordable Housing'. Restricts to meetings that discussed it.
topic.title: Topic

name: search_meetings_semantic
title: Search meetings
